prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: isolated illustrative graphics-card cutout for a PC parts comparison preview.
Primary request: one clean unbranded modern black triple-fan desktop graphics card, matching the premium matte black hardware of a PC build workbench. Three clearly visible circular black axial fans arranged horizontally within a sculpted angular dark graphite metal cooler shroud. Subtle metal heatsink depth below the shroud, a small PCIe gold connector at the bottom, and recognizable left mounting bracket.
Style/medium: extremely polished photorealistic product illustration, believable hardware geometry, soft neutral studio lighting and crisp material fidelity. This is illustrative generic hardware, not a photograph of a specific retail product.
Composition/framing: landscape 1536 by 1024 canvas. The graphics card spans roughly 85 percent of width, centered with generous transparent space around the whole object. Front fan side faces the camera almost directly, with a very slight elevated three-quarter angle so modest top and bottom depth is visible. Long horizontal silhouette. Every edge of the card fits inside the frame.
Background: actual alpha transparency. No surface, no tabletop, no backdrop, no colored fill, no floor shadow outside the object.
Text: none.
Constraints: exactly one graphics card with exactly three fans. No logo, no fake brand, no writing, no stickers, no labels, no watermark, no hands, no cables, no other parts. Preserve natural antialiased alpha edges for use on warm off-white backgrounds.
